from src.dedupe import latest_by_id


def test_last_write_wins():
    records = [
        {"id": 1, "seen": 1},
        {"id": 2, "seen": 2},
        {"id": 1, "seen": 4},
    ]
    assert latest_by_id(records) == [{"id": 1, "seen": 4}, {"id": 2, "seen": 2}]
